g.text: Compile Verilog-A models (ship the build, not the source)
The cell places no Verilog-A file or ComposedFET to compile.
Compile netlist builds every platform the compiler can reach; another platform's build
Publishes the cell's linear network as one S-parameter block sampled over
the Frequency plan, with its devices placed against it. Needs no compiler.
Compiled into one module: R1 (R), Q1 (ComposedFET), C1 (C), X1.L1 (L).
The module has 3 terminals: 1 of the cell's 2 pins, 1 added where outside
Add this library to the workspace
